name: TM7 Korean Pulled Beef Noodles (10-Hour Slow Cook)
ingredients: 750 g beef cheek, trimmed and cut into large chunks

steps.text: At 7:00am, put 150 g quartered onion into the TM7 mixing bowl. Chop 5 sec / speed 5, then scrape down the sides.
Add 30 g garlic and ginger paste, 35 g tomato purée, 45 g dark soy sauce, 45 g rice vinegar, 30 g soft brown sugar, 30 g gochujang paste and 250 g prepared beef stock. Mix 10 sec / speed 3.

Transfer the sauce temporarily to a jug. If using a TM7-compatible blade cover, fit it according to its instructions, then return the sauce. Add 750 g beef cheek in 2-3 large pieces and coat in sauce. Do not exceed the mixing bowl's maximum fill level.
At approximately 7:10am select Slow Cook mode for 8 hours at 90°C. Follow the manufacturer's operating and supervision instructions; do not leave the TM7 running unattended.

At approximately 3:10pm, check the beef. If fork-tender, start a second Slow Cook cycle for 1 hour 50 minutes at 75°C to keep it hot until 5:00pm. If still tough, use 90°C instead until it pulls apart easily. Add a little hot stock if the sauce becomes too thick.

At approximately 5:00pm, remove the beef carefully and shred with two forks. Return to the sauce and mix gently by hand. Taste and adjust the seasoning; for small children check spice level before serving.
Separately heat 600-800 g ready-to-wok udon noodles according to the packet directions until piping hot. Combine noodles and shredded beef in a large serving bowl.
Finish with 15 g chopped coriander, 10 g black sesame seeds and 5 g sesame oil if using. Serve at 5:15pm.
